title: Zariski structure of a supplied saturated fan-center log blowup
statement: Let V,F,c,J be as in [lem-trf-fan-center-pullback-coherence], with J nonempty coherent and with c.pullbackIdeal J nonempty coherent. Let V' be an fs log scheme and b:V' -> V a saturated log blowup of that ideal. Then V'.logStructure.IsZariski: every geometric log-stalk element is a Zariski section germ times a ring unit. This asserts no existence of b, no fan map and no characteristic normalization.

proof.text: Use the affine generation equality of [lem-trf-fan-center-pullback-coherence] and local lifts of the prescribed fan chart. Apply [lem-trf-coherent-log-ideal-chart-construction] and identify the resulting universal log blowup with the supplied b by mutually unique factorizations. Its tensor charts over Zariski base opens are open charts of V'.

Apply [lem-trf-monoid-chart-characteristic-fan] to the global fs chart $R_a\to N'|_{U'_a}$, now that $U'_a$ is locally Noetherian. It gives a local morphism $c_{R_a}:(U'_a,\overline N')\to S(R_a)$ whose inverse-image characteristic sheaf is isomorphic to $\overline N'|_{U'_a}$. Let $M_a$ be the Zariski log structure associated with $R_a\to\mathcal O_{U'_a}$; its associated etale log structure is $N'|_{U'_a}$, since $R_a$ is a chart of $N'$ there. These charts cover $V'$. They glue as follows. By [lem-trf-coherent-log-ideal-chart-construction] $U'_a$ and $U'_b$ are glued along their common localization, with monoid $R_{ab}=R_a[(b-a)^{-1}]$. Since $e-b=(e-a)+(a-b)$ and $e-a=(e-b)+(b-a)$, both $\langle P,e-a\ (e\in E)\rangle[(b-a)^{-1}]$ and $\langle P,e-b\ (e\in E)\rangle[(a-b)^{-1}]$ equal $\langle P,e-a\ (e\in E),a-b\rangle$. Saturation commutes with localization at $s\in Q$: if $ng=q-ks$ with $q\in Q$, then $n(g+ks)=q+(n-1)ks\in Q$. Hence $R_{ab}=R_b[(a-b)^{-1}]$. On the overlap $b-a$ maps to a unit. Adjoining to a chart the negatives of elements mapped to units does not change the pushout $Q\oplus_{\beta^{-1}(\mathcal O^\times)}\mathcal O^\times$. Hence $M_a$ and $M_b$ both restrict to the Zariski log structure associated with $R_{ab}$. These identifications are induced by inclusions of submonoids of $P^{\mathrm{gp}}$, so they satisfy the cocycle condition on triple overlaps. The glued Zariski log structure $M'_0$ has associated etale log structure equal to $N'$ on every $U'_a$, compatibly on overlaps, hence equal to $N'$. Thus $N'$ is a Zariski log structure. The local associated Zariski log structures produce the stalkwise unit-extension criterion IsZariski on the supplied blowup.
